sentence: We should use energy-efficient bulbs at home. It saves energy.
explanation: Energy-efficient bulbs help reduce electricity consumption.

sentence: Please turn the lights off before you leave home.
explanation: Always remember to switch off lights to prevent wasting power.

sentence: Please turn the air conditioner down. I feel cold.
explanation: Lowering the intensity (raising the temperature) of the AC saves energy.

sentence: Rita always encourages her classmates to reuse plastic bags.
explanation: Reusing bags reduces the amount of plastic waste in landfills.

sentence: We can reduce waste by recycling plastic bottles.
explanation: Recycling gives a second life to materials like paper, plastic, and metal.

sentence: I helped pick up rubbish in the country park.
explanation: Cleaning up litter helps protect our natural environment and wildlife.

sentence: To protect our environment, we should avoid using disposable batteries.
explanation: Disposable batteries create hazardous waste; avoiding them helps nature.

sentence: Do not throw away these cans. Please recycle them.
explanation: Items like cans and bottles should be recycled instead of being thrown away.

sentence: If you throw away leftovers, you will create a lot of food waste.
explanation: Throwing away uneaten food contributes to significant food waste issues.

sentence: If you leave the taps on, you will waste a lot of water.
explanation: Always turn off taps to prevent wasting our precious water resources.

sentence: To save water, we should not have long showers.
explanation: Shortening your shower time is an effective way to conserve water.

sentence: I always use up leftovers to reduce food waste.
explanation: Using up all your food helps minimize the amount of waste we produce.

sentence: We can save energy by using rechargeable batteries.
explanation: Rechargeable batteries are better for the environment because they can be reused.
